eisenhower-runs-as-a-democrat.summary: In this world, the voters I interviewed lean 0.5 points further toward Eisenhower than the same people did in 1952 as it was. No state flips. Eisenhower wins, 442–89. The closest call is Kentucky, which holds for Stevenson by 0.1 points. Stevenson wins in 0 of 100 draws. Extremely low confidence. Historical evidence is thin: loose analogies or weak sources only.
